steps.title: The calculators
steps.text: The list on the left holds every calculator ChiSurf bundles: FRET and homoFRET, FRET lines, FCS diffusion, RICS precision, phasor plot, the kappa-squared distribution, the F-test, FCS saturation and the PSF calculator. Hover an entry for what it does.

steps.title: Pick one
steps.text: Click an entry. The calculator is built the first time you open it and keeps its settings while you look at another one.

steps.title: The embedded calculator
steps.text: It is drawn on the right under its description. Every calculator has its own Guide and Help buttons: use them for how that calculator is operated.

steps.title: Help
steps.text: The Help button explains the hub, the list and the keys: Up and Down in the list move the selection while no field of the calculator is being edited.
